title: Abstract What Varies, Reuse Longer Patterns: Efficient Offline Chain-of-Thought Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.27710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline chain-of-thought (CoT) compression creates shorter supervision for efficient reasoning, but per-example compressors repeatedly process similar expressions across traces, wasting compressor budget. Methods that reuse identical text across examples miss longer shared expressions when names, numbers, or formulas change from one question to another. We introduce CRAFT, which abstracts problem-specific details into slots to uncover partially lexicalized expression templates (PLETs) and clusters wording variants into families. Compressing each family representative once yields shared deletion or rewriting edits, which are applied with each occurrence's own details to construct compact, ordinary-text training targets. Compared with per-example rewriting, CRAFT Rewrite reduces weighted compressor budgets by a median 90.7% with a median accuracy loss of 1.21 percentage points, while generating shorter reasoning. translated_title: 《识别变化之处，复用更长模式：高效的离线思维链压缩》
translated_abstract: 离线思维链压缩通过创建更短的监督信号来实现高效推理，但逐样本的压缩器会在不同推理轨迹中反复处理相似的表达式，浪费了压缩器预算。而跨样本复用完全相同文本的方法，在问题的名称、数字或公式发生变化时，会遗漏更长的共享表达式。我们提出CRAFT，它将问题特定的细节抽象为槽位，从而发现部分词汇化的表达式模板，并将措辞变体聚类为族。对每个族的代表性样本只需压缩一次，即可得到共享的删除或改写编辑操作，这些操作结合每次出现的具体细节进行应用，从而构建出紧凑的、普通文本形式的训练目标。与逐样本改写相比，CRAFT Rewrite将加权压缩器预算降低了中位数90.7%，准确率损失中位数仅为1.21个百分点，同时生成更短的推理过程。与跨样本编码方法相比……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: CRAFT通过将问题特定细节抽象为槽位来发现跨样本的部分词汇化表达式模板并聚类为族，只需对每个族的代表进行一次压缩即可复用共享编辑操作，从而将压缩器预算降低中位数90.7%且准确率损失仅1.21个百分点。
en_tdlr: CRAFT abstracts problem-specific details into slots to uncover partially lexicalized expression templates and cluster wording variants into families, compressing each family representative only once to reuse shared edits, which reduces weighted compressor budgets by a median 90.7% with a median accuracy loss of just 1.21 percentage points.
